scope: All seven existing vocal recipes; inventory/source review, reused A07/A21/A25 and bank evidence, one ordinary complete-preset gesture pair. No listening qualification.

programs.name: Blade Choir
programs.description: A covered oo vowel at 16 feet supports a lighter 8-foot choir. Vocal-body resonances stay in place as the notes change; unequal breath entrances and restrained upper effort preserve the dark ensemble color. A covered upper register and rounded main release, preserving the shorter edge.

matched_bank.conditions: 48 kHz, played MIDI60, velocity .8, pressure0, 3-second hold, 1-second tail

programs.name: Golden Pads 52
programs.description: Two softly voiced open-vowel bodies retain their vocal resonances across the keyboard. The upper choir enters later and remains lighter; pressure adds effort and upper color without moving the vowel bands with the played pitch. A gently open body, a defined attack and a clean key release.

matched_bank.conditions: 48 kHz, played MIDI60, velocity .8, pressure0, 3-second hold, 1-second tail

programs.name: Midnight Pads 55
programs.description: A covered oo vowel at 16 feet supports a lighter 8-foot choir. programs.name: Hollow FX 141
programs.description: A voiced ah-formant body carries a fixed 73 Hz mechanical ring, with a brief noisy saw consonant above it. The vocal resonances retain their shape across pitch changes; pressure opens and raises the sustained robotic vowel. A lightly focused filter band over a longer body, with restrained resonance on acoustic models.

gesture.reason: Named-preset tests and A21/A25 captures do not exercise live pitch-bend/wheel changes through an extended choir bank; A07 bend qualification is component-only.
gesture.events: MIDI48 velocity .85 at 0; channel pressure 0->.8 at 1-1.5s; CC1 0->1 at 2-2.5s; pitch-wheel 0->+1 at 3-3.5s, +1->-1 at 4-4.5s, -1->0 at 5.5-6s; note-off at7s, end13s.
gesture.causal_limit: Pressure and wheel occur within one evolving performance. Their separate gains are not isolated here; causal touch evidence comes from A21/A25. Rank telemetry proves commanded pitches, while formant tracking remains attributed to A07.
gesture.coverage_limit: Onset budgets stay captured during the bends. A fresh lower note could admit more modes; the held note does not rebuild. No large ribbon or MPE gesture is qualified by this pair.

limitations: Authored, physically motivated formants, not a fit to singer recordings or a phonetic corpus.
No human listening approval, perceptual preference, universal vowel-recognition or acoustic-equivalence claim.
The 48-mode ceiling leaves the deepest registers short of upper formants; footage and size change coverage.
The two original Oo finishes have full-bank and structural coverage, not a new individual low-note gesture capture.
Full-bank rows are numerical metrics, not PCM identity proofs; high-note PCM identity is separately supplied by A21.
No new native-host, CPU or all-gesture qualification.
